project.name: A.N ERP
project.description: نظام تخطيط وإدارة موارد المؤسسات المتكامل — تدقيق شامل معتمد ومحدث

defects.impact: General Ledger journal posts before inventory adjustment loop; return of recordStockMovement is unchecked; no atomic rollback or outbox retry.
defects.recommendation: Wrap stock adjustments and GL journal into an atomic transaction or register under PENDING_RETRY outbox.

defects.impact: postingEngine.postEntry return result is ignored at line 1418; method returns success:true even if reversal journal fails, with no PENDING_RETRY tracking.
defects.recommendation: Check postEntry return result and attach journalStatus PENDING_RETRY on failure.

defects.impact: postingEngine.postEntry return value is ignored; voucher status updates to POSTED even if posting fails.
defects.recommendation: Verify postEntry outcome before updating document status.

defects.impact: TOCTOU race on remaining PO line quantity without row lock; decoupled stock receive and PO line update.
defects.recommendation: Lock PO line during calculation and combine stock receive and PO update under shared lock.

defects.impact: Absence of dedicated version-tracked migration engine with checksums.
defects.recommendation: Implement structured migration runner with version tracking table.
